category.instructions: Which alert category does this Blue Gene/L RAS log line belong to?

criteria.normal: routine or corrected event, no alert: core dumps being generated, alignment exceptions, corrected cache parity or ddr errors, interrupt statistics, register dumps
criteria.KERNMNTF: Lustre file system mount failed on an I/O node
criteria.KERNREC: error receiving a packet on the tree network
criteria.APPSEV: ciod: the CioStream socket link has been severed
criteria.APPRES: ciod: the CioStream socket connection was reset by peer
criteria.APPTO: ciod: the CioStream socket connection timed out
criteria.APPREAD: ciod: failed to read the message prefix on the control stream
criteria.APPCHILD: ciod: error creating the node map, no child processes
criteria.APPOUT: ciod: login chdir failed with an input/output error
